about: DrakesTestLab Combat Lab: game difficulty baseline. A mid player of each biome (q2 gear of the tier, the tier's skills, real meals, the 'fighter' bot) against each creature at 0-2 stars: win rate alone, per weapon build, and how many such players it takes to win at least half the time. 'fought' numbers are measured fights (8 per cell, 3x clock in lanes, validated against 1x); 'model' numbers are calculated from them and the game's own data (spot-checked: 34 of 36 fresh fights held). Rows written by your own runs replace these. Full rebuild: -testlab-combat "cal-*" then tools/combat_predict.py and tools/combat_build_db.py (takes hours).
